title: Recovery of point and boundary orders from test sequences on cosupport
statement:
Let $N\hookrightarrow Z$ be a smooth closed pair of finite-type $\mathbf Q$-schemes and let $E$ be a finite ordered simple normal crossings boundary [def-trf-strict-normal-crossings-boundary] transverse to $N$ (its local equations restrict to distinct coordinate parameters on $N$). Let $I\subset\mathcal O_N$ be coherent and $d\ge1$. Write $\operatorname{ord}_x I=\sup\{q\ge0:I_x\subseteq\mathfrak m_x^q\}$, with value $\infty$ for zero, and $\operatorname{cosupp}(I,d)=\{x:\operatorname{ord}_xI\ge d\}$. A test transformation is an open restriction, a smooth-center blowup in cosupport with normal crossings with $E$, a product with a line adjoining its zero section to $E$, or a blowup of the intersection of two boundary hypersurfaces. For a cosupport blowup use the strict transform of $N$ and the ideal $e^{-d}\sigma^*I$, where $e$ is the exceptional equation; for the last two operations use ordinary pullback. Two such data on the same ambient scheme and with the same ordered boundary are test equivalent if their finite test sequences coincide. Let $(N,I,d)$ and $(P,J,b)$ be test equivalent, where $P$ is also smooth and has the same local dimension as $N$. At each point $x$ of their common cosupport,
$$\frac{\operatorname{ord}_xI}{d}=\frac{\operatorname{ord}_xJ}{b},\qquad \frac{\operatorname{ord}_{E_i,x}I}{d}=\frac{\operatorname{ord}_{E_i,x}J}{b}.$$
Here $\operatorname{ord}_{E_i,x}I=\sup\{v\in\mathbf Z_{\ge0}:I_x\subseteq\mathcal I_{E_i\cap N,x}^{v}\}$ for a component through $x$, with value $\infty$ when the stalk ideal is zero; it is zero when that component misses $x$. The conclusions apply again on the common cosupport after every common test sequence. No recovery of orders outside cosupport is asserted. lean.statement: theorem test_sequence_order_recovery (S : Embedded (ULift.{u} ℚ)) (M P : Marked S) [LocallyOfFiniteType S.p] [QuasiCompact S.p] (hboundary : IsStrictNormalCrossingsBoundary (⨅ i : Fin S.boundary.length, S.boundary.get i)) (hordered : HasAdaptedNormalCrossingsCenter (⊥ : S.Z.IdealSheafData) (fun i ↦ S.boundary.get i)) (hM : HasAdaptedNormalCrossingsCenter (⊥ : M.N.IdealSheafData) (fun i ↦ (S.boundary.get i).comap M.j)) (hP : HasAdaptedNormalCrossingsCenter (⊥ : P.N.IdealSheafData) (fun i ↦ (S.boundary.get i).comap P.j)) (hdim : ∀ (x : M.N) (y : P.N), M.j x = P.j y → ringKrullDim (M.N.presheaf.stalk x) = ringKrullDim (P.N.presheaf.stalk y)) (hequivalent : RestrictedEquivalent M P) : ∀ (T : Embedded (ULift.{u} ℚ)) (M' P' : Marked T), CommonTestSequence M P M' P' → ∀ (x : M'.N) (y : P'.N), M'.j x = P'.j y → M'.j x ∈ M'.cosupport → P'.j y ∈ P'.cosupport → order M'.ideal x * (P'.marking : ℕ∞) = order P'.ideal y * (M'.marking : ℕ∞) ∧ ∀ i : Fin T.boundary.length, boundaryOrder M'.ideal ((T.boundary.get i).comap M'.j) x * (P'.marking : ℕ∞) = boundaryOrder P'.ideal ((T.boundary.get i).comap P'.j) y * (M'.marking : ℕ∞)
